propositions: Explicit review-plan on bugs with non-test file_impact should run the full blocking rubric instead of the light advisory tier, escalating deterministically at the route_criteria seam to cover both precheck and batch-runner paths.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug-fix commits exceeding 150 non-test lines lacking a current or code-drifted plan-review attestation, using cross-host opcert verification with trusted-environment pinning.

Attestation verification for B2 must read cross-host via opcert_from_record + trusted_env_keyring(record principal) + verify_opcert + compute_validity(profile=DEFAULT, kind=plan-review), never own-env plan_review_status.

Verdict classification must accept {certified, stale-code, stale-head}, flag remaining compute_validity plan-review literals and op-cert verification verdicts {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}, and fail open only on {unavailable, error, unknown-future}.
Non-test line classification rule (tests/** and conftest.py excluded) and the 150-line threshold must be single shared constants across B1 escalation logic and B2 criterion and backtest tooling.
The backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly 13 adjudicated-substantive commits and zero mechanical false positives using the non-test classification rule and threshold.
